summary: Strategy (MicroStrategy) is a bitcoin treasury company: almost all value is the bitcoin it holds minus debt and preferred stock. A revenue DCF doesn't capture this. Value it as bitcoin holdings x BTC price, minus debt and preferred, divided by diluted shares; then compare to the share price (mNAV).
